excluded: RTT/Karn, delayed ACK, complete persist, congestion/recovery
RST challenge validation, SYN/data and urgent/options handling
multiple connections and half-space ambiguous inputs
independent implementation evidence and universal content/output proofs

CONNECTION-PROFILE.interpretation: Inherited single-connection control paths retain validated control shapes, exact sequence checks and configurable user/MSL deadlines. The data extension supersedes the base zero-payload assumption only in ESTABLISHED, within the explicit DATA-SCOPE boundary; data in other lifecycle states remains excluded.

DATA-SCOPE.interpretation: Inherit finite buffers/connection and explicit reassembly, expand accepted ACK+payload/window composition and shrinking windows; first accepted byte wins, raw accepted SEG.SEQ used for WL1. Only ESTABLISHED, no FIN data or full recovery/persist implementation.
